v16_lookup_setup.description: Summons a named pig and lists it. The ENTITY_LIST record prints its entityId; the NBT record by selector prints its uuid. Both feed the next two steps, which the card types by hand.

v16_zero_match_control.description: A selector that matches nothing on purpose. Expect an ERROR record carrying selectorPermission, dimensionsScanned, senderDimension and liveEntities, and the bundle halting on it.

v16_cleanup.description: Removes the pig and stops the session.
